answer: A limited vouching budget stops bulk fake identities. Each member may endorse three newcomers per epoch, and a newcomer needs two endorsements to activate. A cedar registry records each endorsement, so a spent slot cannot be reused, and a ripple of bought endorsements stays visible. Making 1,000 fakes needs 2,000 slots from 667 sponsors; an honest newcomer needs only two. The anchor rule keeps spent slots spent, so the kth fake still needs two new slots. Slot rental is the named failure mode: sponsors caught renting lose future budgets.
